title: Read report case definitions once per request and expose local phase costs
description: Read report case definitions once per request and expose local phase costs
acceptance_criteria: One request reads and validates the case suite at most once while preserving legacy/current case digests, report output, artifact and environment checks, native read counts and genuine lifecycle refusal; a later request observes changed source/case/artifact/native inputs and never reuses stale results; opt-in local phase traces preserve stdout and exit behavior; before/after first-process and repeated measurements record the exact revision, freshly built binary, input sizes, toolchain and censored versus completed native work with no unobserved speedup claim.

answers.constraints: Preserve native authority, fresh gate reads, unknown/timed-out states, existing digests and all proof. Request-local reuse only, with no persistent cache, service, runtime, schema changes, retention/identity changes, or verification exclusions. Existing lessons in specs/cli/context.md require materializing new requirement IDs before linked cases and completing source plus Chough records before native committed verification. Scope approval and human implementation acceptance are separate; this definition has neither. PR37 owns history storage and retention; proposed REQ-cli-028 avoids its reserved IDs. Capped native runs are censored diagnostics, and the direct unwrapped native completion is separate evidence. No Kimi cold-start grade, live adoption, cleanup, native approval/review/ship or merge is implied.
